svg.title: Talking Medicine Label - schematic-style wiring diagram
svg.desc: Battery, TP4056 with LEDs, switch, MT3608, ESP32 with three buttons, PN532, DFPlayer Mini, PAM8403 and two speakers with GPIO labels.
svg.text: Talking Medicine Label - wiring diagram (schematic style; pin positions are NOT the physical board layout)
VCC / CHRG / STDBY LED circuits: see panel below
BTL - never ground L- or R-
5 V and GND at DFPlayer / PAM8403
Indicator LEDs (each with a 1 kOhm series resistor)
LED anode (+) on the resistor side. Red = charging, green = fully charged, blue = main power ON.
UART: DFPlayer TX to ESP32 GPIO16
UART: ESP32 GPIO17 to DFPlayer RX
Analog audio DAC_L to PAM8403 L
Analog audio DAC_R to PAM8403 R
* GND* = ESP32 GND pin beside 3V3: PN532, DFPlayer pin 7 and the 3 buttons.
- DFPlayer pin 10 (GND) goes to the PAM8403 GND between L and R.
- Measure MT3608 output = 5.0 V BEFORE connecting any module.
- Switch: TP4056 OUT+ to COM; OUT terminal to MT3608 VIN+.
- Never connect speaker terminals to ground or to each other (BTL).
- PN532 runs from 3.3 V; never feed 5 V into ESP32 GPIO pins.
- Switch OFF before connecting USB to the ESP32 or charging.
- Buttons (top to bottom): D25 vol -, D26 vol +, D27 language.
- Verify every pin label on YOUR boards first.
